inputs.text: Image 1 is the APPROVED character baseline. Create a minimally refined version of this exact sprite, not a new design. Keep the SAME silver-white hair with pale lavender shadows, same cute violet eyes, face, front bangs, lavender dragon horns, high ponytail tied with a tiny plain black elastic, black suit with white shirt and lavender tie, black pleated skirt, black round shoes, clipboard at her side, and one thick lavender curled dragon tail clearly connected behind her hip. Preserve exact original chibi head to body ratio, identical neutral front facing standing pose and full body framing. Match the exact reference pixel density and low-resolution game art, crisp stepped outlines, large flat pixel clusters, simple two-tone white/lavender hair, no gray hair, no gradients or tiny strands, no added hair accessories. The high ponytail is ONE continuous hair bundle attached at the upper back of the head and falling on the viewer right; no extra loose hair bundle on viewer left, no top bun. Keep the two horns separate from the hair tie. Do not change clothing, face or body size. Light gray plain background, one full body character, no text. Focus on a natural smooth connection from the swept-back hair into the ponytail root. Retain the baseline silhouette and ponytail length.
